race.comment: CALVARY (1) has the strongest winning profile after back-to-back wins, most recently taking a BM58 at Ballina by a head on soft ground after travelling just off the speed and lifting late. Drops back into BM55 company and is a great chance to bring up the hat-trick. LANGAN (8) is the main danger after a nice second at Gatton, and his prior Ipswich run had merit after racing wide throughout. WATER LAD (4) also comes through stronger racing, has the 1.5kg claim and draws the inside. Few boxes ticked. LENNYSTAR (9) was well held on margin last time but had excuses after beginning awkwardly. Drops back to a pet trip on the short turnaround and possesses enough dash to offset the wide draw. Worth another look. EXPRESS STAR (5) has efforts littered through his form that can measure up. Keeping safe in the minors.
